limits: Synthetic DOM keyboard events delivered to actual compiled HttpBar callbacks; not native WebKit input.
Controlled GET presentations establish component GIVEN state; they do not authenticate a taskbar provider.
Actual POST requests are observed only; no backend/window effect is executed.
Keyboard coordinates are fixed0/0 and confer no pointer-position claim.
FocusOnly Bar controls are forbidden by existing snapshot decoder; disabled rows are not made focusOnly here.
Old callbacks after HTTP failure remain stopped; no model state is injected.
No service, native readiness, original scenario or release acceptance.
